criteria.statistical: primary forced-choice word accuracy on w4: one-sided binomial p<0.05 vs 20% chance AND ≥15 points above EVERY baseline AND exact McNemar p<0.05 vs the strongest baseline on w4
criteria.practical: at the frozen threshold on w4: accepted-word precision ≥80%, coverage ≥30% of word trials, control false accepts ≤2/20
criteria.decision: GO = statistical AND practical; INCONCLUSIVE = statistical without practical, OR (beats chance p<0.05 AND practical) without beating baselines — the latter means usable timing-based command classification, not articulation evidence; NO-GO otherwise
